latest_release.body:
## :star: New Features

- Declare read Permissions at Workflow Top Level [#20010](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20010)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Fixes CVE-2026-59329 [#20138](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20138)
- Fixes CVE-2026-59330 [#20140](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20140)
- Fixes CVE-2026-59331 [#20142](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20142)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Bump actions/setup-java from 6.0.1 to 6.1.0 [#19970](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/pull/19970)
- Bump antora from 3.2.1 to 3.2.2 in /docs [#20051](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/pull/20051)
- Bump io.projectreactor:reactor-bom from 2025.0.7 to 2025.0.8 [#19988](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/pull/19988)
- Bump org.springframework.data:spring-data-bom from 2025.1.7 to 2025.1.8 [#19991](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/pull/19991)
- Bump org.springframework.ldap:spring-ldap-core from 4.0.5 to 4.0.6 [#20015](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/pull/20015)
- Update micrometer to 1.16.9 [#20056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20056)
- Update reactor to 2025.0.9 [#20026](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20026)
- Update Spring Security Project Plugin to 1.0.21 [#19942](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19942)
- Update spring-data-bom to 2025.1.9 [#20032](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20032)
- Update spring-framework to 7.0.11 [#20033](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20033)
- Update spring-ldap to 4.0.7 [#20057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/20057)

## :nut_and_bolt: Build Updates

- Apply Spring Security Maven Plugin [#19941](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19941)
- Apply Spring Security Settings Plugin [#19943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19943)
- Remove Gradle Wrapper Upgrade Task [#19937](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19937)
- Remove Spring Release Plugin [#19938](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19938)
- Remove Unneeded Artifactory Support [#19940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19940)
- Update Spring Release Dependencies [#19939](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19939)
- Use Release Train Version Convention [#19931](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security/issues/19931)
